scenarios.name: Groene contour treated as hard exclusion (nature first)
Designation taken at face value (no Natura/ganzenrust carve)

provenanceBasis.provenanceNote: NC-Z-04 (art. 6.5a lid 3) makes solar fields inside the Groene contour implicitly temporary via a compensation duty; this variant executes the strictest reading — exclusion — instead.

provenanceBasis.rationale: The carve follows from the toelichting on art. 5.5, not from an explicit lid; dropping it isolates how much area the interpretive carve actually costs. Purely analytical — not a legal reading.
provenanceBasis.provenanceNote: NOT legally grounded as a reading of the verordening: the baseline's carve (NC-Z-03) is the defensible interpretation; this variant removes it to measure its footprint.
